paragraphs.p1: I am a Senior Software Engineer based in Brazil, specializing in Frontend Engineering with React, Next.js and TypeScript. I work with international teams in English on investment, trading and business applications.
paragraphs.p2: My 8+ years of experience span frontend modernization, authentication, onboarding, KYC, financial transactions and analytics dashboards. At AZX, I develop Penzack, an investment and trading platform with more than one million users.
paragraphs.p3: I also bring full-stack experience with Node.js, API integration, data modeling and AWS. At James Moto Shop, I led end-to-end development of a commercial platform, connecting the public portal to an administrative ERP and coordinating a multidisciplinary team.
paragraphs.p4: My engineering practice includes automated testing with Jest, React Testing Library, Vitest and Cypress, production monitoring and attention to accessibility and performance. I am also exploring AI Engineering, LLM integrations and automation for products and development workflows.

item-01.description: Develop React, Next.js and TypeScript features for Penzack, an international investment and trading platform with 1M+ users. Use Zustand and TanStack Query, contribute to App Router modernization, internationalization, performance and reliability, and integrate Sentry monitoring. Collaborate daily with international teams in English.

item-02.description: Led end-to-end development of a consortium sales platform handling 1,000+ leads per month. Integrated the public portal with an administrative ERP using Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Prisma and AWS (EC2, S3, RDS). Refined the lead-to-contract and checkout flows, coordinated a multidisciplinary team and established code quality practices.

item-03.description: Developed enterprise frontend features for clients including Lacta and Universal Music. Migrated a large React application from Create React App to Next.js and built interactive analytics dashboards with Recharts and report exports.

item-04.description: Designed and delivered custom web applications for business clients, including a fintech solution supporting secure financial transactions for thousands of daily users. Integrated frontend workflows with backend services and collaborated with cross-functional teams.

item-05.description: Built web and mobile products from UX design to implementation. A sales management system improved contract closing rates by 40%; a call monitoring dashboard reduced administrative task time by 60%; promotion features in a local business aggregator app contributed to a 6% sales increase for participating companies.

penzack.thesis: Frontend Engineering for Penzack at AZX, an investment and trading platform with 1M+ users.
penzack.context: Penzack is the international investment and trading product developed at AZX, my employer. The platform serves more than one million users.
penzack.challenge: Support onboarding, identity verification and financial transactions across regional markets and languages, alongside real-time trading experiences.
penzack.responsibility: Build and maintain frontend features with React, Next.js and TypeScript. Collaborate with international teams in English on authentication, onboarding, KYC, trading interfaces and transaction flows.
penzack.solution: Implemented automatic sign-in, email verification and KYC status handling, plus deposit and withdrawal interfaces including Pix and OXXO. Use Zustand and TanStack Query for application state and API data. Contributed to Next.js App Router and Server Actions modernization, browser compatibility fixes, multilingual responsive interfaces and Sentry production error monitoring.
penzack.impact: Delivered financial and onboarding features within a platform serving 1M+ users, with support for regional payment journeys and multilingual experiences.

james-moto-shop.thesis: End-to-end development of a commercial platform connecting a public portal and ERP, handling 1,000+ leads per month.
james-moto-shop.context: A consortium sales business needing a public-facing website connected to its administrative ERP.
james-moto-shop.challenge: Connect lead acquisition and the lead-to-contract journey with administrative operations, while keeping the product maintainable and visible in search.
james-moto-shop.responsibility: Led end-to-end development, architected the solution and coordinated a multidisciplinary team. Established code quality practices to support predictable delivery.
james-moto-shop.solution: Built the portal and ERP integration with Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript, Node.js and Prisma. Used AWS EC2, S3 and RDS for cloud deployment and refined checkout and conversion flows through UX improvements.
james-moto-shop.impact: Delivered a commercial platform processing more than 1,000 leads per month, connecting the public website to administrative operations.

elint.thesis: React to Next.js modernization and analytics dashboards for enterprise clients.
elint.context: Enterprise applications serving clients including Lacta and Universal Music, with reporting and data visualization needs.
elint.challenge: Modernize a large React application and make operational data easier to analyze and export.
elint.responsibility: Developed and maintained frontend features, migrated an application from Create React App to Next.js and implemented analytics interfaces.
elint.solution: Migrated the existing React application to Next.js. Built interactive charts with Recharts and added report export capabilities for operational analysis.
elint.impact: Delivered a Next.js migration and interactive analytics dashboards with report exports for enterprise products.
